text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh...! As expected, it really doesn't 
fly straight so easily, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...It's because you're tensing up way too 
much.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Picture drawing the bow with your bones, 
not your muscles. ...Give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: L-Like this...? Uwoooooh!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Direct hit! Heheh, thanks, 
Brian!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well! This is quite a surprise... To think 
that Brian is actually playing the role of 
teacher.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I was surprised too! I was just 
practicing archery, when out of nowhere, 
she told me to come over!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well! It hardly ever flew straight, so 
that actually worked out!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Hmm... What brought this on, I wonder?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I was merely fulfilling an obligation.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Mm? Obligation...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I see! In that case, quite a few 
things come to mind.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
For instance... look! Weren't you mending 
Brian's track jacket the other day?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I should put something she likes on 
it," she said, even adding a little meat 
applique for her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, here it is, here it is! The torn part 
caught my eye, so I just couldn't resist!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And then, there was that time you brought 
Brian back when she was sleeping outside.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It was right before curfew, so as a dorm 
head, that was a real lifesaver!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha! It's not just that I can't leave 'em 
alone... I just can't take my eyes off 
this one!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So... don't you think you're starting to 
understand by now?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? So does doing the right thing mean 
you're gonna... no way?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Sis just nagged at me, that's all. 
Told me to return the favor for once."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hearing it over and over gets annoying. 
...That's all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Brian...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Haha, is that right... Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Who would've thought Brian would look 
after someone! Good for you, Hishi Ama.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! An opportunity like this 
doesn't come around very often, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm gonna let you take care of me 
to my heart's content!
